subject: Distance Internal Error when creating coverage layer

messages.author: ef1bec828cf9a73d
messages.subject: Distance Internal Error when creating coverage layer
parts:
Dear all, 

I am attempting to run some analyses using the DSM engine in Distance 6.0.  I have got as far as getting my data in, and my study area layer and transect layer appear to be loaded in without any problems.  I have now got to the stage where I am trying to create the coverage layer, created as a child of the Study Area layer.  However, when I click "coverage" from the "Layer type" drop down menu in the "Create New Layer" dialogue box, I get the following error message:

The following internal error has occurred in Distance:

Record '1' not found.
(Error raised from: Distance.ClsGrid.SetDefault)
(Error source: D6DbEng.DataLayer.RecordShape)
(Error number: -2147214294)

After a quick Google search I have found a bug report from 2012 on bugzila - bug no.106 (http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=106)

Does anyone know whether this error message has been caused by me doing something wrong, or is it an actual bug?  If it is, is there a way to fix it?

Thanks in advance

Matt

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Distance Internal Error when creating coverage layer
parts:
Matt:

Yes, I believe we have seen that one before.  The "Record 1 not found" message is a give-away that the shapefile you used to define your study area layer lacks a field called "LinkID".

Have a look at the section on "Importing Existing GIS Data | Prepare the Shapefile" in Chapter 5 of the Users Guide.  That is on page 62 of the users guide that ships with Distance 6.2 release 1.  This describes the creation of this mandatory field.

The coverage grid is looking at your study area shape file to determine the area onto which to drop a mesh of points presumably for your prediction grid layer.

Let us know if that solves the problem.
